The '''Alliance Exclusionary Zone''' was established by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] around [[Centerpoint Station]] and the five inhabited planets of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] during the [[Blockade of Corellia]].<br /> The [[Corellian Exclusion Zone]] was eventually merged into this larger blockaded area.
